composition: DeliveryLedger lifecycle hooks + TLSWitnessedMixedLedger; MixedRecipientInbox/MixedDeliverySender; shared fixed-route mTLS framing

trust.gateway: Trusted signer checks signed mixed admission and authoritative committed result; recipient verifies gateway signature and shape, not full delegation chain or DP execution proof
trust.witness: Linearizable authenticated nonrollback authority assumed; loopback reference implementation
trust.recipient: Cooperating durable inbox; whole-store nonrollback external assumption, negative control demonstrates repeat acceptance after rollback

signed_fields.action_digest: SHA256 canonical internal action JSON, not COSE wire action bytes; signed admission records in authoritative ledger bind wire action to internal action
signed_fields.catalog_digest: SHA256 UTF-8 canonical JSON labels with ensure_ascii=False; ordered unique public labels, each 1..64 UTF-8 bytes
signed_fields.result: Full 8B-byte vector, each uint64be <=N; count B=1 with empty catalog/digest/labels. Sum can exceed N; no omitted zero components

lifecycle.L3: Delivery ticket and QUEUED outbox atomic, only after full RELEASE; no Agent fetch/readiness API
lifecycle.prepare: Bind complete result/metadata to trusted operation, sign once, encrypted immutable envelope persisted and witnessed before network
lifecycle.receive: mTLS certificate pin before application bytes; receiver verifies sender certificate and MixedDelivery signature, closed fields, shape and original lifetime; BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes full-record acceptance and sequence
lifecycle.retry: Same full signed envelope and original acceptance time; new challenge binds each ACK
lifecycle.confirm: ACK binds exact request/envelope hashes/challenge/receiver; encrypted evidence and ACKED state witnessed atomically; no new charges
lifecycle.expiry: No first acceptance after expiry; historical valid ACK may be stored after expiry/revocation; missing ACK at expired head remains blocked until a future mixed terminal protocol

verification.full_pipeline: N3 B4 histogram then N3 count, shared domain/ancestor accounts, signed delegated admission, encrypted storage, authenticated witness, mTLS inbox and ACK
verification.B64_scope: Signed transport/parser fixture with 64 maximal UTF-8 labels and 512-byte vector, plus maximum-field-size parser/framing check; not a B64 full pipeline performance test
negative_controls: wrong mTLS identities and wrong signer
whole recipient store rollback allows repeated first acceptance

remaining: Base result-only profile intentionally has no terminal closure; MixedTerminalDeliveryLedger extension supplies result-free ACCEPTED/CLOSED protocol
Production receiver authority nonrollback/failure domains and bounded retention; conditional local recovery implemented in TLSWitnessedMixedRecipientInbox
Independent COSE/CDDL interop and parser review
Full observable trace proof and physical timing/multihost evaluation
Production witness/CA/signing/storage key lifecycle and scalable journal
